research.scope: main capital, final constrained portfolio; no new attribution, impact2x or Go/No-Go evaluation
research.opening_policy: cash; initial construction exempt from turnover, all costs charged
research.order_policy: fixed adjusted units at T end-of-day; one-session validity; sell then proportional cash scaling
research.decision_time: T end-of-day, after daily inputs; eligibility source T-1
limitations: historical data vintages not proven point-in-time
adjusted fractional units, no round lots or dividends cash ledger
realized full-day VWAP/volume is an execution approximation
unfilled orders expire; next weekly decision uses actual holdings and cash
